name: mason
description: Context engineering MCP server — concept maps for codebases, change impact, and Confluence wiki sync. Concept maps built via Map-Reduce for complete coverage. MCP-only.
long_description: Mason persists a feature-to-file concept map in `.mason/snapshot.json` so AI assistants can answer architecture questions without grepping the codebase from scratch. Also exposes change impact analysis (co-change history, references, related tests) and git history aggregation (hot files, stale dirs, commit patterns).

tools.name: mason_init
tools.description: Start here. Checks if Mason is set up for this project. If not, returns a `playbook` of questions the assistant must walk the user through (concept map setup). Once the walkthrough is done, call `mason_complete_init`. Idempotent.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: mason_complete_init
tools.description: Mark the project as initialized. Call after walking the user through the playbook returned by mason_init. Writes .mason/project.json.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

confluenceConfigured.description: True if Confluence was successfully configured during init

tools.name: mason_set_confluence
tools.description: Configure Confluence credentials. Without `spaceKey`: validates credentials and returns available spaces for the assistant to relay. With `spaceKey`: persists to ~/.mason/config.json. Warn the user that the API token will be visible in chat history before they paste it.

spaceKey.description: Confluence space key. Omit on the first call to list spaces.

parentPageId.description: Optional parent page ID under which Mason's index page is created

tools.name: export_to_confluence
tools.description: Sync the concept map to Confluence as product-readable wiki pages: index page, one page per feature, and a changelog. Hand edits outside mason:start/end markers are preserved. Requires mason_set_confluence.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

parentPageId.description: Override the configured parent page ID

featurePagePrefix.description: Prefix for each feature page title

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Load the concept map — a lookup table from features and flows to the files that implement them. Requires init. When stale, returns the existing map plus a diff of changed files + previews so an incremental save_snapshot call covers the update.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: generate_snapshot_batch
tools.description: Map step of the concept-map build. Returns one batch of source files (skeletons of every file in the batch plus a few deeper-read bodies for grounding) and a system prompt instructing you to derive features and flows for ONLY this batch. Call repeatedly with the returned `nextOffset` until it is null, calling `save_partial_snapshot` between calls.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

offset.description: 0-indexed file offset to start the batch at. Omit on the first call.

tools.name: save_partial_snapshot
tools.description: Persist the partial concept map you derived for one batch. Call once per batch with the `batchId` from `generate_snapshot_batch`.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: reduce_snapshot
tools.description: Reduce step of the concept-map build. Returns every partial snapshot plus a system prompt asking you to merge them into one project-wide map. After producing the unified map, call save_snapshot.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: save_snapshot
tools.description: Save a concept-to-files map as a persistent project snapshot. Persists across conversations.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

features.description: Map of feature names to their implementing files

flows.description: Map of flow names to ordered file chains

tools.name: get_impact
tools.description: Change impact analysis. Returns git co-change history, references, and related tests for the given files. Use before editing a file to understand what else might need updating.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

files.description: File paths or names to analyze

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Git history analysis: commit conventions, stale directories, frequently changed (hot) files.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: full_analysis
tools.description: Run a complete project analysis in one call: git stats, project structure, curated code samples, and test-to-source mapping. Recommended starting point on a new codebase.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: get_code_samples
tools.description: Get previews (~60 lines) of representative source files: entry points, config, hot files, test examples, and one file per directory.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

count.description: Maximum number of files to sample
